name: shakespeare-in-love-2026
label: Shakespeare in Love - look A, Ink & Quill
description: Look A (Ink & Quill) for Shakespeare in Love, 5 - 12 December 2026, as drawn on the look sheet (tools/foyer-look-sheet/sil-2026/build_sil_sheet.py, LOOKS[A]). The ink as the ground: blue-black, paper-white words, a pale teal accent and one red heart, all set in IM Fell English, a 17th-century printer's face. The publicity's ink blot sits bottom-left as a texture. Complements the licensed publicity (R2) without reproducing it. DRAFT: Hugh has not yet chosen a look; this is the recommended one, published so he can see it live.

_colour_notes.method: WCAG 2 relative-luminance ratios, measured 11 October 2026 (Cowork) with the look sheet's own contrast() function. 'On blot' is against the texture's darkest fill #000A0D, where text can also sit.
_colour_notes.text: Paper white. 15.82:1 on ground, 17.74:1 on the blot; body floor is 10:1.
_colour_notes.accent: Pale teal for headlines' emphasis, CTAs and the {braced} emphasis word (emphasis falls back to accent because poster_red is deliberately unset). 10.14:1 on ground, 11.37:1 on the blot; well above the 7:1 emphasis floor (Underdog's poster_red was 5.76:1).
_colour_notes.secondary: The publicity's red heart. 3.49:1 on ground - RULE AND MOTIF COLOUR ONLY, never text (C17 colour rule; foyer-surfaces.md).
_colour_notes.muted_text: Ink-wash grey-teal for eyebrows, footlines and small print. 9.65:1 on ground, 10.82:1 on the blot; above the 7:1 muted floor.
_colour_notes.poster_red: Not set, on purpose. A red light enough to reach 7:1 on this ground (#EE849A, 7.14:1) reads pink, not heart-red. With it unset, {braced} emphasis uses the accent (10.14:1) and the alert eyebrow uses the text colour.

_font_notes: IM Fell English is in APPROVED_FONTS and its .woff2 is in platform/obs-helper/assets/fonts/ - no new font for look A (R3). Looks B and C would need Kaushan Script or Caveat Brush installed first.
_headline_case_notes: Period serif headlines read as written, as on the look sheet (C14). Eyebrows, footlines and badges stay in capitals.
_watermark_notes: The house Criterion roofline mark, bottom-right, opposite the ink blot.
_texture_notes: R4. The ink blot, bottom-left, as on every look-A card of the sheet. Text over it keeps its ratio (see colour notes).
_marks_notes: The look sheet's two motifs (tools/foyer-look-sheet/sil-2026/build_sil_sheet.py): the red heart before the show-identity eyebrow (welcome 'Tonight at the Criterion', and the during-the-acts cards whose eyebrow is the show name), and the ink-blot full stop after the title on welcome. Drawn by Cowork, not traced from the publicity. Heart is secondary (3.49:1) - a mark, never text. Rendered only once the engine supports `marks` (C23); until then the engine ignores this block.
_motion_notes: Photos move gently, as the house does. No particles: the motes are a Popcorn/Underdog flourish that would fight a calm period look.
